t0: Sign-in is off, so everyone who reaches this server acts as this user.
t1: Single sign-on. Your groups come from your sign-in provider and decide what you may do.
t2: A Launchway account. Groups decide what you may do.
t3: Who you are signed in as, the keys you use, and what you are told about.
t9: Clone and push over SSH from your own computer. Also lists the server's fingerprints to check.
t10: Sign your commits and tags so they show as verified.
t11: Tokens that let a script or the command line act as you until they expire.
t13: Choose what you are told about, by e-mail or in your inbox, and when.
t14: Let an AI assistant read your {runs} and, if you allow it, act on them.
t17: Let people use the accounts they already have, with groups deciding what each may do.
